name: matrix metallopeptidase 16

function.text: MMP16 encodes matrix metalloproteinase-16. Annotated molecular activities include metalloaminopeptidase activity and metalloendopeptidase activity. It participates in proteolysis and protein processing.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
